Highlights:
# AI TOP 100E SSD 1TB

## Specifications

- Interface
- PCI-Express 4.0x4, NVMe 1.4

- Form Factor
- M.2 2280

- Total Capacity
- 1024GB

- NAND
- 3D NAND Flash

- External DDR Cache
- LPDDR4 1GB

- Sequential Read speed
- Up to 7,200 MB/s

- Sequential Write speed
- Up to 6,500 MB/s

- Dimension
- 80 x 22 x 3.5 mm

- Mean time between failure (MTBF)
- 1.6 million hours

- Max. Operating Power
- Read: 10.8W; Write: 11.0W

- Power Consumption (Idle, PS3)
- 30mW

- Power Consumption(PS4, L1.2)
- 3mW

- Temperature (Operating)
- 0°C to 70°C

- Temperature (Storage)
- -40°C to 85°C
